criteria.name: Subject knowledge and accuracy
criteria.description: Accuracy, command over topic, ability to explain concepts. Judge ONLY against the supplied module reference content and expected learning outcomes; if none is supplied this criterion is N/A. Flag factual errors separately from acceptable simplifications.

criteria.name: Training structure and flow
criteria.description: Opening, agenda, sequencing, transitions and logical progression.

criteria.name: Communication effectiveness
criteria.description: Clarity, articulation, appropriate language, comprehensibility. Judge comprehension, never accent or conformity to English.

criteria.name: Trainer presentation and delivery
criteria.description: Confidence, posture, voice modulation, visual presentation. Observable behaviour only.

criteria.name: Participant engagement
criteria.description: Questions, responses, interaction, participation opportunities. Assess actual interaction, not the number of questions asked.

criteria.name: Practical application and demonstrations
criteria.description: MSME examples, demonstrations, exercises, case studies.

criteria.name: Time and session management
criteria.description: Pacing, time allocation, discipline and coverage.

criteria.name: Inclusivity and audience adaptability
criteria.description: Encouragement, accessibility, adapting explanations to learners.

criteria.name: Professionalism and technical delivery
criteria.description: Preparedness, appropriate use of materials. Do not penalise audio/video quality outside the trainer's control.

criteria.name: Recap and learning closure
criteria.description: Summary, key takeaways, knowledge checks and next steps.

anchors.0: Not demonstrated (only used when SCORE_FLOOR_MODE=zero_anchor; distinct from N/A)
anchors.1: Poor - competency largely absent or serious deficiencies
anchors.3: Competent - meets the minimum expected standard
anchors.4: Strong - consistently effective, with minor improvement areas
anchors.5: Excellent - highly effective, consistent and exemplary
